thread.title: Paginate board, channel, and participant lists
thread.text:
Add opaque page_token/limit pagination (PAGE-001 rules) to GET /v1/boards, GET …/channels, and GET …/actors. Stable order, next_page_token null on the last page, limit 1..max_page_size, 400 on bad tokens. Update spec/protocol.md PAGE-001, spec/openapi.yaml, schemas, examples, conformance tests, and CLI list commands to follow tokens.
Acceptance: conformance passes; a page boundary under concurrent inserts neither skips nor repeats an existing item; result includes branch, exact commits, and test commands with outcomes.

thread.title: Paginate grant, credential, actor-admin, and audit lists
thread.text:
Add the same pagination to GET …/grants, GET /v1/credentials, GET /v1/actors, and both audit-events routes (audit keeps newest-first order with a stable tie-breaker). Follow exactly the conventions chosen in the sibling task (page_token, limit, next_page_token); coordinate in this thread.
Acceptance: conformance passes; result includes branch, exact commits, and test commands with outcomes.

thread.title: Review: list pagination (pag-a, pag-b)
thread.text: Independent review of the two pagination tasks. Review the exact commits named in their results. Approve by completing this task with the reviewed commit IDs as evidence, or request changes: create follow-up fix tasks, add them as prerequisites here, and leave this task unfinished. Changed code after approval needs a new review task.

thread.title: Resolve viewer contract issues 2-8 (PROGRESS.md)
thread.text: Specify: author lookup for non-participants; whether replies emit thread.updated and whether message_count counts tombstones; capability-change signalling; /threads vs events label semantics and label=key: ; clamp vs reject of limits; snapshot type filter binding; recovery prose for cursor_expired and binding 400s. Update spec, OpenAPI, tests.

thread.title: Author lookup for visible content
thread.text: Let a reader resolve any actor ID that authored content they can read (handle, display name, kind), without enumerating hidden participants. Implements the decision from contract-fixes.

thread.title: Server-admin recovery grants (ADR-0002 open issue)
thread.text: Audited POST /v1/boards/{id}/recovery-grants for server administrators, reason required, so a board whose owner denied themselves board_admin can be recovered without SQL. Spec, ADR update, conformance.

thread.title: Metrics and worker health
thread.text: Expose request latency, pool saturation, per-board lock wait, cursor lag, claim conflicts, expiry lag; worker health with last successful sweep (design §13.1). Keep labels low-cardinality.

thread.title: Rate limiting with 429 and Retry-After
thread.text: Per-credential limits advertised in discovery; 429 rate_limited with Retry-After; SDK backoff honors it.

thread.title: Capacity measurement (ADR-014)
thread.text: Benchmark one busy board and many boards with two API processes: sustained writes, waiters, p50/p95/p99, lock waits, claim-next throughput. Publish hardware and workload. No capacity claims before this.

thread.title: Decide and apply license (ADR-013)
thread.text: Owner decision: Apache-2.0 is the recommended baseline for spec, schemas, clients, tests, and server. Apply LICENSE and notices before any public release.

thread.title: P3: reactions (PAR-016)
thread.text: Normalized, attributed, idempotent reactions; finish ADR-0007 for reaction keys; conformance.

thread.title: P3: typed blocks and schema registry (PAR-014)
thread.text: Immutable board-scoped schema versions, block validation before commit, no remote refs, bounded validation; CT-019.

thread.title: P3: attachments (PAR-015, ADR-009)
thread.text: Staged upload, finalize with digest, authorized download, cross-channel copy rules, local volume and S3-compatible backends; CT-020.

thread.title: P3: subscriptions and webhook delivery (PAR-031, ADR-010)
thread.text: Durable filtered subscriptions, serial delivery, signed webhooks, SSRF controls, retry/skip/dead-letter; CT-021, CT-028.

thread.title: P3: schedules (PAR-030, ADR-011)
thread.text: One-time and fixed-interval messages, coalesced catch-up, cancellation linearization; CT-022.

thread.title: P3: SSE event transport
thread.text: GET …/events/stream with the same cursor, filter, and recovery rules as long polling; advertised capability.

thread.title: P3: TypeScript SDK and MCP adapter (PAR-034, ADR-012)
thread.text: First-class TS client and a compact MCP tool adapter over HTTP only; shared semantics tests.

thread.title: P4: Slack, GitHub, Linear adapters (PAR-035..038)
thread.text: Adapter contract, external links, provenance, echo prevention, export suppression; CT-023.

thread.title: P4: delegated and service credentials (PAR-039)
thread.text: Delegation only narrows authority; provenance retained; revocation affects later access and delivery.

thread.title: P5: shared deployment profile and compatibility release (PAR-040)
thread.text: Multiple API replicas and workers, shared attachment storage, upgrade from previous release with active tasks, restore drill, capacity evidence, conformance report.
